items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in Sports Management, Business Administration, Recreation Administration, Facilities Management, or related field.
Athletic Event Management and Operations
Direct all planning, coordination, and execution of home athletic contests, tournaments, special events, and campus-hosted championships.
Through subordinate staff, develop event management plans, staffing assignments, and operational procedures.
Through subordinate staff, coordinate game-day operations including officials, event personnel, security, medical coverage, facility setup, signage, and guest services.
Ensure compliance with conference, NCAA, university, and risk management requirements.
Lead event operations meetings and coordinate with coaches, officials, vendors, and campus partners.
Evaluate event effectiveness and implement continuous improvements to enhance the student-athlete and spectator experience.
Manage emergency response and incident management procedures during athletic events.
Ticketing and Revenue Operations
Oversee all athletic ticketing operations, including ticket sales, customer service, box office procedures, and financial reconciliation.
Develop strategies to increase attendance and revenue through ticketing initiatives and fan engagement programs.
Manage ticketing software systems and reporting processes.
Ensure accurate financial controls, cash handling procedures, and compliance with university policies.
Coordinate ticketing support for special events, tournaments, and postseason competition.
Generate attendance and revenue reports for Athletics leadership.
Facilities Management and Maintenance
Provide leadership for the operation, maintenance, and scheduling of athletic facilities and venues.
Develop preventative maintenance programs to ensure facilities remain safe, functional, and aesthetically maintained.
Coordinate facility repairs, capital improvement projects, and contracted maintenance services.
Collaborate with campus facilities management on infrastructure planning and maintenance priorities.
Monitor facility conditions and address operational deficiencies proactively.
Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and risk management requirements.
Assist with long-range facility planning and facility master plan initiatives.
Staff Supervision and Leadership
Directly supervise facilities personnel, maintenance staff, event operations personnel, and student employees.
Provide sport supervision to at least one athletic team.
Recruit, hire, train, schedule, and evaluate staff performance.
Foster a culture of customer service, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop operational procedures, training programs, and performance standards.
Provide leadership and professional development opportunities for staff members.
Budget Administration and Resource Management
Develop and manage operational budgets for facilities, maintenance, event operations, and ticketing.
Monitor expenditures and ensure responsible stewardship of university resources.
Prepare budget forecasts and recommend resource allocations.
Oversee procurement of equipment, supplies, and contracted services.
Identify cost-saving opportunities and operational efficiencies.
Strategic Planning and Administrative Duties
Participate in Athletics leadership meetings and strategic planning initiatives.
Develop policies and procedures related to event management, facilities, and operations.
Maintain operational records, reports, and compliance documentation.
Support departmental goals related to student success, community engagement, and institutional growth.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Advanced degree in Sports Administration, Business Administration, Higher Education, or related field. Preferred
Licenses and Certifications
Valid California Drivers License & Participation in DMV Pull Program.
Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in athletics operations, event management, facilities management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing athletic events and facility operations.
Experience supervising full-time staff and student employees.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Knowledge of budget management and financial controls.
Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and flexible schedules as required by athletic events.
Experience in collegiate athletics at the NCAA, NAIA, or equivalent level. Preferred
Understanding of ticketing systems, financial reconciliation, and customer service principles. Preferred
Experience overseeing athletic facilities and maintenance programs. Preferred
Knowledge of event security, crowd management, and risk management practices. Preferred
Comprehensive knowledge of athletic event management and operations.
Ability to develop and maintain collaborative relationships across campus and within the community.
Strong leadership and supervisory skills.
Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and student-centered service.
Knowledge of facility maintenance practices and preventive maintenance programs Preferred

This position will be required to complete all pre-employment requirements, including a background investigation, the University's credentialing process, and verification of licensure and/or certification through the appropriate California licensing or certifying board(s), as applicable.
Background check  required.
